authoritative_public_input.athlete_request: I would like 1 extra practice block aimed at this basketball priority: Improve agility during short basketball movements. Build around the schedule and resources I supplied. One other person included in this headcount is an adult basketball coach available throughout all listed windows to give movement cues.

basketball_background.reported_skill_level: I want to improve control when combining familiar movements.

authoritative_public_input.food_question: For the food "Turkey, whole, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted", how many kilocalories of energy are recorded for 120 g?
goals: Improve agility during short basketball movements

restrictions: Only one athlete moves at a time; the coach may give cues from a stationary support position outside the movement path. Other people wait outside the active area.
space.usable_area_description: A marked basketball half-court floor with baseline, sidelines, key, wing positions and three-point line is available throughout all listed windows. There is a separate waiting area. The listed hoop is available.

qualifications: The athlete has reported a skill level of 'I want to improve control when combining familiar movements.'
The adult coach is available throughout all listed windows to give movement cues.
questions: Is there a specific drill or exercise that can help improve agility during short basketball movements?
How can the adult coach provide effective movement cues and feedback to the athlete?
parsed_object.rationale: The athlete has reported a goal of improving agility during short basketball movements, and the adult coach is available to provide movement cues. The 'Early-Cross Jab Series' drill can be used to improve agility, but the time and rest requirements are unknown
recommendations: Agility training can be done with cones. Set up a course with cones and have the athlete move through it, focusing on quick changes of direction and speed. This will help improve agility during short basketball movements.
The adult coach can provide movement cues and feedback to the athlete as they move through the course. This will help the athlete develop their skills and build confidence in their movements.
unresolved_issues: Unknown time and rest remain unknown for the drill 'Early-Cross Jab Series'.
